scope.interpretation: shared-cohort OOF evaluator-side attribution; not private or independent validation and not a new model score

target_free_before_receipt: load catalog, blind traces, projected features, OOF scores
single_post_receipt_attach: open the five pinned numeric label members once
open the pinned train_explore proxy once only to bind absent-C100 targets to catalog metadata

exclusive_primary_funnel_in_order.candidate_absent_at_c100: target is absent from raw C100 on every causally eligible turn
exclusive_primary_funnel_in_order.admission_grace_state_rejection: target is C100-reachable and either the frozen ranker chooses it on an eligible turn that admission rejects, or it is excluded only by actual served-state/history while an eligibility-reset replay would expose it
exclusive_primary_funnel_in_order.candidate_present_but_ranker_failure: target is C100-reachable but neither frozen admitted ranking nor grace state exposes it on an eligible page

present_by_c200.reason: frozen blind trace ends at exact C100

present_by_c400.reason: frozen blind trace ends at exact C100

absent_at_c400.reason: frozen blind trace ends at exact C100

candidate_frontier.rule: do not infer C200/C400 from C100 or from unrelated adaptive-depth artifacts; resolve only in separately preregistered target-blind recall probes

nonexclusive_diagnostics.old_intent_or_question_lifecycle: target occurs in raw C100 or the grace page before eligible_from but is absent from raw C100 on every eligible turn
nonexclusive_diagnostics.query_or_attribute_information_insuffici: on every eligible turn query_specificity_fraction or active_constraint_count_fraction is zero, OR every reachable target row has zero compatible slot evidence and positive missing/unknown evidence
nonexclusive_diagnostics.catalog_metadata_missing: target catalog row is absent, title/categories are empty, all descriptive evidence fields are empty, or price is null; serialize aggregate field counts only

include: C10/C20/C50/C100 recall for all sessions and the 18 misses
wall time, P95 transform latency, RSS, GPU peak
source, artifact, result and commit hashes

decision_rule.largest_primary_count: select the largest exclusive primary bottleneck; ties resolve candidate_absent_at_c100, then candidate_present_but_ranker_failure, then admission_grace_state_rejection
decision_rule.next_required_stage: run the single preregistered fixed-two-page-grace plus frozen score-priority composition smoke; if it is No-Go, use the largest bottleneck to choose candidate recall versus ranking/state work
